info.name: Nearby Teacher — Teacher Profile and Geography APIs (Mock Responses)
info.description: Focused collection with saved mock response examples. In Postman, import this latest JSON, expand Teacher > Profile, then select the example under a request to view its saved response. Geography lookup examples are under Common. Set baseUrl and, for Teacher requests, a verified teacher bearer token. Draft examples: Teacher > Profile > Draft — Save and Resume. Save step 3, restore next day with nextStep=4, then continue step 4. Each request includes a saved response. Shared teacher/institute six-step APIs: open Teacher or Institute > Shared Profile API. Both use /profiles/me and the bearer account type; existing /teacher/profile requests remain teacher-only.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Six-step editor. Steps 1–5 save profile sections, the separate photo request uploads a file, and Publish completes step 6.

item.name: Draft — Save and Resume
item.description: Set baseUrl and token. Save steps 1–2 using the Profile requests first, then run these requests in order. Successful steps persist draft data and progress. GET restores saved data; no separate draft API is needed. Saved examples illustrate a first-time draft.

request.description: Save profile steps 1 and 2 first. This saves step 3 and draft progress automatically. Expected completedSteps=[1,2,3], nextStep=4. There is no separate draft endpoint.

response.name: 200 — Draft saved through step 3; next step 4

originalRequest.description: Save profile steps 1 and 2 first. This saves step 3 and draft progress automatically. Expected completedSteps=[1,2,3], nextStep=4. There is no separate draft endpoint.

item.name: 2. Resume draft — Open step 4 next day

request.description: Call after login or reopening the app. Prefill saved user/profile/subjects and open profileDraft.nextStep. This example assumes steps 1–3 were saved, so nextStep=4. Read-only; does not reset progress or change lastSavedAt. Set token to the same teacher account.

response.name: 200 — Draft restored; steps 1–3 saved, resume step 4
